subject: pharmacology
title: Antidepressants, lithium and mood stabilisers

steps.tx: **SSRIs** (fluoxetine long half life with self taper, sertraline cardiac safe in post MI, paroxetine anticholinergic with worst **discontinuation syndrome**, escitalopram QT watched) need **2 to 4 weeks lag** with early **suicide risk** (energy before mood) demanding follow up; continue **6 to 9 months** post remission then taper slowly. Hyponatraemia (SIADH elderly), sexual dysfunction and GI upset manage by switching; sertraline with citalopram suit cardiac and elderly. Overdose safety exceeds tricyclics vastly.
steps.say: Antidepressants lag weeks with early suicide energy: follow closely. Sertraline suits hearts; paroxetine stops hardest.

steps.tx: **SNRIs** (venlafaxine hypertensive at dose with brutal discontinuation, duloxetine pain with incontinence benefit) and **TCAs** (amitriptyline, imipramine; **cardiotoxic sodium blockade** with anticholinergic delirium, lethal in overdose, enuresis and pain niches) follow; **MAOIs** (phenelzine, tranylcypromine; **tyramine cheese crisis**, washout 2 weeks with SSRIs, 5 with fluoxetine) reserve atypical and resistant depression. TCA overdose (wide QRS, arrhythmia) gets bicarbonate with charcoal; hypertensive crisis gets phentolamine.
steps.say: Venlafaxine hypertenses and stops brutally. TCA overdose widens QRS: bicarbonate. Cheese with MAOI strokes: washout.

steps.tx: **Atypicals** fill niches: **mirtazapine** (weight gain with sedation suiting elderly anorexia, agranulocytosis rare), **bupropion** (no sexual effects, smoking cessation, **seizures** in bulimia banning), vortioxetine (cognitive claims), trazodone (priapism, sleep low dose). **Serotonin syndrome** (SSRI plus MAOI or tramadol or linezolid: **clonus** with hyperthermia and agitation) is cooled with benzodiazepines and **cyproheptadine**, culprits stopped; **neuroleptic malignant syndrome** (rigidity with bradykinesia, dopamine blockade) differs needing dantrolene or bromocriptine.
steps.say: Clonus with fever on two serotonergics is serotonin syndrome: cool, cyproheptadine. Rigidity with bradykinesia is NMS.

steps.tx: **Lithium** (narrow therapeutic index 0.6 to 1.2, **hypothyroidism** with nephrogenic **diabetes insipidus**, **Ebstein anomaly** in pregnancy, NSAIDs and thiazides raising levels, toxicity with coarse tremor, confusion and seizures dialysed) anchors bipolar prophylaxis with levels and renal thyroid watched. **Valproate** (teratogenic neural tube with PCOS and pancreatitis, broad antimanic) and **carbamazepine** (autoinduction, SJS HLA screened) follow; **lamotrigine** (slow titration dodging Stevens-Johnson, bipolar depression pole) completes. Dehydration with salt loss intoxicates lithium.
steps.say: Thirsty polyuric tremor on lithium is toxicity: levels, dialyse severe. Bipolar pregnancy prefers lamotrigine titrated slow.
